channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Chicagoans Pay Tribute To Minneapolis Nurse Alex Pretti
item.description: Candles, photos and flowers were placed at a makeshift memorial honoring Pretti outside the Jesse Brown Veteran Affairs Medical Center. A candlelight vigil is planned for Wednesday outside the center.

item.title: Neighbors Raising Money To Buy ‘Hero’ Crossing Guard Meals At Local Restaurants
item.description: Chicagoans launched a GoFundMe to thank Joe Sass, who carried a West Ridge student across a flooded street during a water main break. Sass plans to donate half the proceeds and dine at restaurants impacted by ICE with the other half.

item.title: Proposed 7-Story Bucktown Apartment Building Moving Forward In City Council
item.description: The building would replace an existing strip mall with 60 apartments and a two-level parking garage, plus ground-floor retail. It needs approval from the zoning committee and full City Council.

item.title: Leaders Share Tips On How Chicagoans Can Best Support Immigrants At Block Club Event
item.description: Speakers directly affected by Operation Midway Blitz shared their experiences during a panel hosted by Block Club Chicago. More than 200 people attended.

item.title: Chicago’s 1st Director Of LGBTQ+ Affairs Will Prioritize City’s Youth, Older Residents, He Says
item.description: Longtime public health advocate Antonio King will work inside the Mayor’s Office to coordinate LGBTQ+ policy, youth outreach and services for aging residents.

item.title: Warlord Chef-Owner Charged With Sharing Sexual Photos Of Woman
item.description: Trevor Fleming, the chef behind the trendy Avondale restaurant, is accused of sending sexual images of a woman to other people without her consent. She and another woman have been granted orders of protection against him, records show.

item.title: Substitute Teacher With Long History Of Child Molestation Charges Fired From South Side Catholic School
item.description: Brett Smith, who worked as a substitute teacher this January at Queen of Martyrs Elementary School in Evergreen Park, has been fired due to child molestation allegations and conviction in Illinois and other states, according to the Archdiocese of Chicago.

item.title: New Music Fest Coming To Union Park Will Be Headlined By Kaytranada, Keyshia Cole And Kelly Rowland
item.description: Forever Mine Music Festival will take place May 23-24 at Union Park featuring three stages of house and R&B artists. Tickets go on sale Friday.

item.title: Chicago Nurses, Veterans Grow Memorial For Alex Pretti Outside VA Hospital, Rally Against ICE
item.description: Chicago hospital workers and union members came together Tuesday after the killing of one of their own: Alex Pretti, an intensive-care nurse at a VA hospital, shot at least 10 times by federal agents in Minneapolis.

item.title: Woman Shot 5 Times By Border Patrol Asks Judge To Unseal Body Cam Footage
item.description: Court filings say sealed evidence from Marimar Martinez's case could shed light on federal use of force and correct misinformation about her case.
